intro: Nine disciplines in four pillars. AI isn't a tenth service bolted on: it's how I work across all of them, to research faster, explore more directions and automate the parts nobody should do by hand.

oneTeam.title: One person, no hand-offs
oneTeam.body: This is an independent studio run by me, Mohammed. The person who draws your logo also builds your site and wires up your automations, so nothing gets lost between agencies and you always know who is accountable.

baseline.title: Measured, not promised
baseline.body: I record how long the work takes today before building anything, then measure again after launch. You see the real difference, not a projection.

human.title: Humans stay in the loop
human.body: Decisions that need judgment, like pricing, approvals or anything a client reads, keep a person in the chain. The machine handles the copying, sorting and chasing.

data.title: Your data stays yours
data.body: Automations run on accounts you own, with only the access they need. Nothing is used to train third-party models, and you get every credential at handover.

person.title: A person replies, not a bot
person.body: When you message me, you get me. The automations I build for you can be just as honest about when a human takes over.

call.title: Intro call
call.body: Thirty minutes to understand the goal, the audience and what success looks like. No pitch deck.

scope.title: Scope and quote
scope.body: A written scope with deliverables, timeline and a fixed price, so you know exactly what you're getting.

build.title: Design and build
build.body: Work in short rounds with previews you can click through, and feedback folded in as we go.

launch.title: Launch and handover
launch.body: Everything shipped, documented and handed over: files, access and a walkthrough for your team.

engagement.title: Two ways to work together

project.title: Fixed-scope project
project.body: A defined outcome, like a new identity, a website or an automation, with a fixed price and timeline agreed upfront.
project.bestFor: Best for launches, rebrands and new products

retainer.title: Monthly retainer
retainer.body: A set amount of design, development or automation work each month, prioritised with you as needs change.
retainer.bestFor: Best for ongoing content, iteration and support

engagement.pricingNote: Pricing is quoted per scope after a short call. Every project is different, and a fixed written quote beats a vague range.

notDo.title: What I don't do
items: Resell stock templates as custom work
Buy followers, reviews or fake engagement
Pass AI output off as finished without a human edit
Start without a clear decision-maker on your side
Take on more projects than I can personally deliver

items.q: How much does a project cost?
items.a: It depends on scope, so I quote each project after a short call. You get a fixed written price before any work starts, and it doesn't change unless the scope does.
Each service above lists a typical timeline. Your exact dates go into the written scope, and I tell you early if anything is at risk.
Design work includes two structured rounds of revisions per stage. Development includes fixes for anything that doesn't match the agreed scope.

items.q: Do you work with clients in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf?
items.a: Yes. Most of my clients are in the Gulf, and I work remotely across your time zone. Calls happen on Google Meet, Zoom or WhatsApp, whichever you prefer.

items.q: Can you work in Arabic and English?
items.a: Yes. I write, design and build in both, including proper right-to-left layouts, Arabic typography and bilingual content management.

items.q: What happens to my data in AI workflows?
items.a: Automations run on accounts you own, with the minimum access needed. Sensitive data isn't sent to tools that train on it, and you receive every login and API key at handover.

items.q: Do I own the final files and code?
items.a: Yes. Once the project is paid, you own the designs, source files and code outright.

cta.title: Not sure which service you need?
cta.body: Describe the problem instead. I'll tell you honestly what would help, and what wouldn't.
